connector.name: Liepin Jobs
connector.registryDescription: Liepin job search and resume workflows backed by the official Liepin MCP server.
connector.summary: Hosted at open-agent.liepin.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xllinbupt account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
